rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a temple used as a place of worship.

example.english: We went to that temple to worship.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 go2 gaan1 miu6 baai3 san4

rows.note: Use this for the anatomical area at the side of the head behind the eye.

example.english: My right temple has been hurting all morning.
example.traditional: 我右邊太陽穴痛咗成朝。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau6 bin1 taai3 joeng4 jyut6 tung3 zo2 seng4 ziu1

rows.note: Use this for the sidepiece or arm of a pair of glasses.

example.english: The temple of my glasses is loose, so they keep slipping down.
example.traditional: 我副眼鏡腳鬆咗，成日跌落嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fu3 ngaan5 geng2 goek3 sung1 zo2 seng4 jat6 dit3 lok6 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a Jewish synagogue, rather than a general place of worship.

example.english: We went to the temple on Saturday for the service.
example.traditional: 我哋星期六去猶太會堂做禮拜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 jau4 taai3 wui6 tong4 zou6 lai5 baai3
